# Conceptualist Systems: International Exam Past Papers & Textbooks Library

> Independent international exam study archive; not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Pearson plc / Edexcel or Cambridge University Press & Assessment (CAIE). Conceptualist Systems (https://www.conceptualist.uk) is a free, zero-ad academic archive indexing 74,958 unique Pearson Edexcel (IAL & IGCSE) and Cambridge International (AS & A Level, IGCSE & O Level) Question Papers (QP), Mark Schemes (MS), Examiner Reports (ER), Grade Thresholds (GT), Inserts (IN), 154 Student Textbooks & Worked Solution Banks, 591 Listening Audio tracks with synced closed captions (CC), and 212 practical Data Files (78,820 total archived files).

## Core Platform Capabilities
- **Board Switcher Architecture:** Isolated switching between Pearson Edexcel International (IAL & IGCSE) and Cambridge International (AS & A Level, IGCSE & O Level) with zero cross-board search collisions.
- **Side-by-Side Split View Reader:** Open paired Question Papers (QP) alongside Mark Schemes (MS) or Cambridge Inserts (IN), plus one-click Grade Thresholds (GT) and Examiner Reports (ER).
- **Resizable Two-Page Book Spread Mode:** Read student textbooks and standalone past papers in a 2-Page side-by-side spread with Pure OLED and Academic Dark reading modes.
- **In-Browser Worked Solution Bank Reader:** Stream all 14 Edexcel IAL Mathematics Worked Solution Banks (P1-P4, M1-M3, S1-S3, D1, FP1-FP3) chapter-by-chapter directly in the browser.
- **Synced Listening Audio & Subtitles (CC):** Play MP3 and multi-track ZIP listening examinations above the Question Paper with clickable time-synced transcripts.

## Primary Archive Hubs
- [Library Homepage](https://www.conceptualist.uk/): Interactive subject, unit, and examination year navigator.
- [All Edexcel Past Papers](https://www.conceptualist.uk/papers): Searchable Pearson Edexcel catalog.
- [Edexcel IAL Past Papers](https://www.conceptualist.uk/ial): 19 International A-Level subjects.
- [Edexcel IGCSE Past Papers](https://www.conceptualist.uk/igcse): 43 International GCSE (9-1, Regional R, and Modular 4W*) subjects.
- [Cambridge International Hub](https://www.conceptualist.uk/cambridge): Cambridge AS & A Level (31), IGCSE (45), and O Level (31) subjects.
- [All Cambridge Past Papers](https://www.conceptualist.uk/cambridge/papers): Searchable Cambridge International (CAIE) catalog.
- [Cambridge AS & A Level](https://www.conceptualist.uk/cambridge/a-level): International AS & A Level past papers, mark schemes & grade thresholds.
- [Cambridge IGCSE](https://www.conceptualist.uk/cambridge/igcse): Cambridge IGCSE (A*-G & 9-1 equivalents) past papers, inserts & grade thresholds.
- [Cambridge O Level](https://www.conceptualist.uk/cambridge/o-level): Cambridge O Level past papers, mark schemes & grade thresholds.
- [All International Textbooks & Solution Banks](https://www.conceptualist.uk/textbooks): 154 Edexcel & Cambridge student books, coursebooks, workbooks, lab books, and IAL Maths Solution Banks.
- [Edexcel Textbooks & Solution Banks](https://www.conceptualist.uk/textbooks/edexcel): Pearson Edexcel IAL & IGCSE student books, answer PDFs, and Worked Solution Banks.
- [Cambridge International Textbooks](https://www.conceptualist.uk/textbooks/cambridge): Cambridge AS & A Level, IGCSE & O Level coursebooks, workbooks & revision guides.
- [Listening Audio Archive (MP3 & Live CC)](https://www.conceptualist.uk/audio): 591 listening audio tracks and synced transcripts.
- [IT & Computer Science Practical Data Files](https://www.conceptualist.uk/data-files): 212 practical exam source ZIPs.
